# netskope_rbac_role_config (Data Source)

RBACRoleConfig DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_rbac_role_config" "this" {}

locals {
  # Build a name -> tenant-specific ID map for all API groups.
  # API group IDs are tenant-specific and cannot be hardcoded portably.
  api_group_id = {
    for g in data.netskope_rbac_role_config.this.api_groups : g.name => g.api_group_id
  }

  # Build a map of api_group name -> list of obfuscatable field names, excluding "app"
  # (keeps "App names, URLs, and destination IPs" readable; obfuscates user, source, userip, file)
  obfuscation_fields = {
    for g in data.netskope_rbac_role_config.this.api_groups :
    g.name => [
      for o in data.netskope_rbac_role_config.this.obfuscation :
      o.obfuscation_name if o.api_group_id == g.api_group_id && o.obfuscation_name != "app"
    ]
  }
}

resource "netskope_rbac_role" "helpdesk" {
  name        = "helpdesk-readonly"
  description = "Read-only helpdesk role with privacy obfuscation"

  api_groups = [{
    api_group_id = local.api_group_id["events_alerts"]
    permission   = "r"
    obfuscation = {
      properties = local.obfuscation_fields["events_alerts"]
    }
  }]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_groups` (Attributes List) Full catalog of API groups with their tenant-specific IDs, names, and maximum permission levels (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_groups))
- `functions` (Attributes List) UI function groupings mapping function names to the API group IDs they contain (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions))
- `obfuscation` (Attributes List) Full catalog of obfuscation fields, keyed by api_group_id (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--obfuscation))

<a id="nestedatt--api_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_groups`

Read-Only:

- `api_group_id` (Number) Tenant-specific numeric ID for this API group
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name shown in the Netskope UI
- `highest_permission` (String) Maximum permission level supported by this group (r, rw, or rwa)
- `name` (String) Internal API group name (e.g. "events_alerts")


<a id="nestedatt--functions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `functions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Function ID
- `name` (String) Function name (e.g. "Administration", "Network")
- `sub_functions` (Attributes List) Sub-function groupings within this function (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions--sub_functions))

<a id="nestedatt--functions--sub_functions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `functions.sub_functions`

Read-Only:

- `api_group_ids` (List of Number) API group IDs included in this sub-function
- `id` (Number) Sub-function ID
- `name` (String) Sub-function name



<a id="nestedatt--obfuscation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `obfuscation`

Read-Only:

- `api_group_id` (Number) API group this obfuscation field belongs to
- `obfuscation_field_id` (Number) Numeric ID of this obfuscation field
- `obfuscation_label` (String) Human-readable label (e.g. "Usernames", "Source location information", "User IPs")
- `obfuscation_name` (String) Internal name used in role PUT requests (e.g. "user", "source", "userip", "file", "app")
